title: W1-16 round 3 — progression and encumbrance
contention_at_start: GO — 4 browser instances, 24 processes, load 14.19/4 cores = 3.55 per core, ceilings 6 instances / 4.0 per core. Offline half first regardless.
brief: Round 2's producer exists and is real; it reads the wrong hand. Fix (1) the two right hands — the hand that is weighed and the hand that fights must be one object; (2) count the shipped equip_weight / shield weight so tiers are reachable with no invented weights; (3) OVERLOADED forbids sprinting; (4) the first-engagement delta collapse that eats a Feather offset. Do NOT re-tune the ladder — the critic verified it exact at 13 loads with three cliffs.
must_land: 1. Equipping a weapon changes equip load AND the fight swings the weapon you equipped, with before numbers from the critic's own instruments
2. All four tiers reachable by dressing with no invented weights; report the reachable percentage range per tier
3. OVERLOADED forbids sprinting, measured in metres against a button-up control
4. CONSUMPTION (RI-MTH07) and delete-the-fix per rule 6, with a teardown watched going red
next_step: implement _handWeight() in engine.js; route right/left equips through setLoadout; seed _equipLoadBase at _buildCombat; add OVERLOADED sprint denial
